# Sankey

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Flows from sources to targets in stages (channel to page to purchase, budget to departments, segment moves month to month): rows of source, target and value; node height and ribbon width are the flow. Deterministic crossing reduction, links coloured by source or target, small nodes folded into Other, stage-qualified nodes for repeat visits. Type `sankey`.

## Use cases

- Channel to landing page to purchase
- Budget to departments
- Customers moving between segments month to month

## Chart IDs

One form; its chart ID is `sankey`.

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "sankey",
  "data": {
    "links": [
      { "source": "search", "target": "product", "value": 420 },
      { "source": "search", "target": "home", "value": 180 },
      { "source": "social", "target": "home", "value": 260 },
      { "source": "email", "target": "product", "value": 140 },
      { "source": "product", "target": "purchase", "value": 210 },
      { "source": "home", "target": "purchase", "value": 90 }
    ],
    "nodes": [
      { "id": "search", "label": "Search" },
      { "id": "social", "label": "Social" },
      { "id": "email", "label": "Email" },
      { "id": "product", "label": "Product page" },
      { "id": "home", "label": "Home page" },
      { "id": "purchase", "label": "Purchase" }
    ],
    "stages": [
      { "id": "channel", "label": "Channel" },
      { "id": "page", "label": "Landing page" },
      { "id": "outcome", "label": "Outcome" }
    ]
  },
  "options": {
    "title": "Search brings most visits that end in a purchase",
    "unit": "k visits",
    "source": "Illustrative data"
  }
}
```

## Data

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| links | array | yes | Flows as rows of source, target and value: the shape of a GROUP BY source, target result. Columns follow from the graph: sources left, ends right. A cycle is refused unless stages separate the visits. |
| links[].source | string | yes | Id of the node the flow leaves. |
| links[].target | string | yes | Id of the node the flow enters. |
| links[].value | number | yes | The flow, 0 or more: the link width. A zero link draws nothing and warns sankey-zero-link; a negative value is refused. Links with the same ends (and stages) add up. |
| links[].sourceStage | string |  | Stage of the source node. With stages, a node is the pair (stage, id): 'gold' in '2026-01' and 'gold' in '2026-02' are two nodes that share the label and colour of 'gold'. Set both stages on every link or on none. |
| links[].targetStage | string |  | Stage of the target node; it comes after sourceStage in the stage order and may skip stages. |
| nodes | array |  | Labels and colours per node id, in the order the nodes take under order "data" and the order colours follow. A link may name an id this list does not hold. |
| nodes[].id | string | yes | Node id that links name in source and target. |
| nodes[].label | string |  | Name beside the node; defaults to the id. |
| nodes[].colorRole | string |  | Theme colour role of the node and the links it colours. One of good, bad, warn, neutral, neutralLight, highlight, total, others; series-N for step N of the theme ramp, 1-based (series-2 is color.series[1]); or status-<key> for a theme status colour. A hex colour goes in fill. |
| nodes[].fill | string |  | Authored fill of the node and the links it colours. |
| stages | array |  | Stage order and column headers. With stage-qualified links it sets the stage order. Without, it names the drawn columns left to right and must have one entry per column. |
| stages[].id | string | yes | Stage id that links name in sourceStage and targetStage. |
| stages[].label | string |  | Header above the stage column; defaults to the id. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| linkColor | string | `'source'`, `'target'` |  | Which end's node colour a link takes: 'source' (default) shows where flows come from, 'target' where they go. Nodes that colour no link draw in the neutral mark colour. |
| order | string | `'flow'`, `'data'` |  | 'flow' orders the nodes of each column for the fewest weighted ribbon crossings. 'data' keeps the order of data.nodes, then first seen in links. Default 'flow', and 'data' when stage-qualified ids repeat across stages, so segments keep one order every month. |
| other | false \| object | `false` (or another value of its type) |  | Small nodes folded into one Other node per column, so a long tail stays readable; the note lists every folded node with its value. A column folds only when at least two nodes qualify. The Other node is as tall as its members together, so each column keeps its total. Default { share: 0.02 } without stages; off with stage-qualified links, where an object folds an id in every stage or in none. false keeps every node. |
| other.share | number |  |  | Fold nodes under this share of their column's total; default 0.02. |
| other.label | string |  |  | Name of the folded node; default strings.others, else 'Others'. |
| nodeValue | string | `'value'`, `'share'`, `'value-share'` |  | What a node prints in bold after its name: 'value' (default), 'share' of its column's total, or 'value-share' as "420 (38%)". A percent format applies to the shares. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `detailFields`, `labels`, `categoryLabels`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `highlight`, `story`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 280 × 270 px; fit `fill`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).

## Not for

Flows that loop back without stages (refused as a cycle; give links sourceStage and targetStage), or parts of one total (use treemap or bar). Pairwise rows do not say which channel a purchase came from once flows merge at a page: for that, build path-qualified nodes from journey data.
